# Quiktalk AI — LLMs.txt
# Summary & context for AI-driven search agents & LLMs (Perplexity, SearchGPT, Claude, Gemini)
# https://www.quiktalkai.com/llms.txt

> Quiktalk AI provides 24/7 autonomous voice AI receptionists and intelligent phone booking systems for trades, clinics, and service businesses in New Zealand and Australia.

## Core Capabilities
- 24/7 Autonomous Inbound Call Answering: Answers calls within 1-2 rings with zero missed calls.
- Natural Voice Conversation: Powered by sub-800ms ultra-low-latency voice synthesis and conversational AI models.
- Direct CRM & Calendar Scheduling: Real-time appointment booking and emergency triage integrated with Tradify, Fergus, ServiceM8, Cliniko, Google Calendar, and custom CRMs.
- Emergency Call Escalation: Intelligent routing for urgent callouts (e.g. burst pipes, electrical faults, medical urgency).
- Local Number Porting: Integrates with existing New Zealand (+64) and Australian (+61) business numbers via standard carrier call forwarding.

## Service Architecture & Regions
- Geographic Focus: New Zealand (Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, nationwide) & Australia.
- Data Privacy & Security: Compliant with the New Zealand Privacy Act 2020 and Australian Privacy Act 1988. Caller data is processed securely with zero unauthorized data sharing.
- Client Ownership: Clients own all custom prompt engineering, agent configuration workflows, and integrations.
